question: Green plants and certain bacteria manufacture their own food. Which one of the following nutrition process do they adopt?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Autotrophic Nutrition**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Autotrophic Nutrition**

 
 
• **It is an organism that can produce its own food using light, water, carbon dioxide, or other chemicals. Because autotrophs produce their own food, they are sometimes called producers. Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
 
• Plants are the most familiar type of autotroph, but there are many different kinds of autotrophic organisms. Algae, which live in water and whose larger forms are known as seaweed, are autotrophic.<
